research_notes: A useful future close schema should include target_sec, start_ts, pre_close_ts, close_end_ts, elapsed_sec, overshoot_sec, close_overhead_sec, classification, and independent_failure fields.
It should also reference scheduler pre-arm evidence rather than duplicate mutable scheduler assumptions.
The current close will use this conceptual structure as far as available timestamps permit.
State/current will then summarize last clean target and next target.
No scheduler rewrite will occur at close.
